title: ECLGS 5.0 Guarantees Reach ₹1.55 Lakh Crore Across 4,11,497 Issued Guarantees
summary: MSMEs account for 98% of total guarantees under Cabinet-approved ₹18,100 crore outlay.

blocks.content: MSMEs account for 98% of total guarantees under Cabinet-approved ₹18,100 crore outlay.

items: Guarantee Progress: 4,11,497 guarantees issued totaling ₹1,55,229 crore (around ₹1.55 lakh crore).
MSME Share: MSMEs account for 98% of total guarantee count and 82% of total guaranteed amount.
Borrowing Limits: Additional credit up to 20% working capital (cap ₹100 cr for MSMEs; cap ₹1,500 cr for airlines).
